title: Georgia Grant Packet Assembler
tagline: SSI-safe OneGeorgia / GVRA / SBDC / DOBE / PASS packet drafts. Human submits.
what_it_does: Produces an eligibility memo, narrative, budget, attachment checklist, SSI/PASS risk memo, and official submit-channel note from facts the buyer pastes. Cites live official URLs. Stops before submit.
who_it_is_for: Georgia founders, disability-owned or rural small businesses, and agents hiring a grant specialist for a single packet.
free_eval: This outline plus a sample eligibility section using public program pages only.
